item.title: Inter-hemispheric contrast in the sensitivity of polar amplification to sea-ice coverage conditions
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 26 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04185-5

Arctic amplification is projected to weaken and lose seasonality in future sea ice-free climates, whereas Antarctic amplification will remain comparatively weaker and more stable, suggests a study combining distant past and future climate-model simulations with paleoclimate data assimilation.
